title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Not in a great headspace to talk at the moment. Trying to contemplate what i’ll do without a job.
Crazy. I’m sorry. I was actually calling you to tell you I’m quitting my job
This doesn’t have anything to do with me, does it?
I’m here to talk if you want. I’ll talk to you soon. I’ve been facing similar thoughts the past three days ... trust me, man, you will be fine.
